scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Artificial Limbs to Workers and their Dependents- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance for Artificial Limbs to Workers and their Dependents scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was officially launched on 1st April 2015.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to workers who have lost their limbs due to accidents or other health-related issues.

The scheme aims to enhance the quality of life for these workers and their dependents by facilitating access to artificial limbs.

The specific goal of the scheme is to ensure that at least 1,000 workers receive financial assistance each year.

This initiative is particularly focused on workers engaged in the unorganized sector.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is set at a maximum of INR 50,000.

This amount is intended to cover the costs associated with procuring artificial limbs.

Eligible beneficiaries include workers who are registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

Dependents of these workers are also eligible for assistance under this scheme.

To qualify for the scheme, applicants must be residents of Haryana.

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years.

There is no upper age limit specified for eligibility.

Income criteria for applicants stipulate that their monthly income should not exceed INR 15,000.

This income limit ensures that the assistance is targeted towards economically weaker sections of society.

Educational qualifications are not a prerequisite for eligibility under this scheme.

The application process for the scheme involves several specific steps.

Interested applicants must first obtain the application form from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board's official website or their local office.

The application form must be filled out completely and accurately.

Applicants are required to submit a copy of their identity proof along with the application.

This can include documents such as an Aadhaar card or voter ID.

Additionally, a medical certificate confirming the loss of limb must be included.

This medical certificate should be issued by a recognized medical authority.

Proof of income is also required to establish eligibility.

This can be in the form of a salary slip or an income certificate from the local revenue department.

Once the application form and supporting documents are compiled, they must be submitted to the nearest office of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The application must be submitted within 30 days of the incident leading to limb loss.

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The review process typically takes about 15 to 30 days.

If approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

The disbursement of funds is generally completed within 15 days of approval.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is the implementing authority for this scheme.

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana.

Contact details for the Haryana Labour Welfare Board can be found on their official website.

The board has multiple regional offices across Haryana to assist applicants.

Statistics show that since its inception, the scheme has benefited over 5,000 workers and their dependents.

The scheme has been well-received, with a growing number of applications each year.

In the financial year 2022-2023, the board allocated a budget of INR 5 crore for this scheme.

This budget reflects the government's commitment to supporting workers in need.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to improve the welfare of laborers.

Other welfare measures include health insurance and educational assistance for workers' children.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board also conducts awareness programs about this scheme.

These programs aim to educate workers about their rights and available benefits.

Workers are encouraged to apply for assistance as soon as they experience limb loss.

This ensures timely support and reduces the financial burden on families.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of rehabilitation for affected workers.

By providing financial assistance for artificial limbs, the scheme promotes inclusivity.

It allows workers to regain mobility and independence.

The Haryana government regularly reviews the scheme to assess its effectiveness.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the services offered.

The scheme aligns with the national goal of providing social security to all workers.

It reflects the government's commitment to enhancing the living standards of disadvantaged groups.

In conclusion, the Financial Assistance for Artificial Limbs to Workers and their Dependents scheme is a vital initiative.

It provides essential support to workers who have suffered significant life changes due to limb loss.

By offering financial assistance, the scheme plays a crucial role in their rehabilitation and reintegration into society.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to strive for the welfare of laborers through this and other initiatives.
